labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync log: saver cannot write campaigns
labels.value: Campaign sync skipped {0} appeal(s): the person who saved them cannot create and edit Campaigns, or does not have the Campaign Sync permission set. Click Sync all appeals on the Campaign sync page to catch them up.

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync log: save too large to copy
labels.value: Campaign sync did not copy the appeals in a very large save, because copying them in the same transaction would have gone past Salesforce limits. The appeals are saved without their Campaigns. Click Sync all appeals on the Campaign sync page to give them their Campaigns.

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync log: platform refused the campaign
labels.value: Campaign sync could not copy the appeal "{0}" to its Campaign: {1}

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync log: linked campaign not found
labels.value: The Campaign linked to the appeal "{0}" was deleted or is not visible to you. If it was deleted, clear Campaign ID on the appeal to have a new Campaign made; if it still exists, give the person saving the appeal access to it.

labels.shortDescription: Appeal save refused: Campaign ID is not one
labels.value: Campaign ID must be the record ID of a Campaign (18 characters, starting 701), or empty.

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync log: new campaign left unlinked
labels.value: Sync all appeals created the Campaign {0} for the appeal "{1}", could not store its Campaign ID on the appeal, and could not delete the Campaign again: {2} Delete that Campaign, or paste its ID onto the appeal once the appeal can be saved.

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync log: what a Sync all appeals pass did
labels.value: Sync all appeals, pass {0} of 2: {1} Campaigns created, {2} updated, {3} already up to date, {4} could not be copied (each has its own Warning).

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync page: what it does
labels.value: Each appeal gets a matching Salesforce Campaign, kept up to date when the appeal changes, so Campaign Members and marketing tools work. Nothing on a Campaign is copied back, and no Campaign is ever deleted.

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync page: org has no Campaigns
labels.value: This org has no Campaigns (Salesforce Platform licenses do not include them), so Campaign sync cannot run here.

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync page: the setting is off
labels.value: Campaign sync is off. Switch on Copy appeals to Campaigns in the Giving section of Nonprofit Settings, then come back to sync your appeals.

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync page: the setting is on
labels.value: Campaign sync is on. Saving an appeal creates or updates its Campaign.

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync page: appeals with a Campaign
Campaign sync page: viewer cannot write Campaigns
labels.value: You cannot create and edit Campaigns, so appeals you save get no Campaign. That needs Campaign access and the Marketing User box on your user record, both in Setup.

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync page: viewer cannot sync all
labels.value: Only someone with the Manage Nonprofit Settings permission can sync all appeals.

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync page: sync all button
Campaign sync page: a sync is running
labels.value: Sync all appeals is running in the background. Reload this page in a minute to see the new counts. Anything that could not be copied is in the Error Log.
Something went wrong on the Campaign sync page. The details are in the Error Log.
